# FAMER — Famous Mexican Restaurants

## What is FAMER?
FAMER is the #1 directory of authentic Mexican restaurants in the United States, with over 25,000 verified listings across all 50 states. We provide ratings, reviews, menus, hours, and contact information.

## Key Pages
- Homepage: https://restaurantesmexicanosfamosos.com.mx
- English version: https://famousmexicanrestaurants.com
- Find restaurants by state: https://restaurantesmexicanosfamosos.com.mx/restaurantes-mexicanos-en-[state]
- Find restaurants by city: https://restaurantesmexicanosfamosos.com.mx/restaurantes-en-[city]
- Mexican dishes guide: https://restaurantesmexicanosfamosos.com.mx/platillos

## Data Coverage
- 25,000+ Mexican restaurants in the USA
- All 50 US states + 32 Mexican states
- Verified ratings from Google, Yelp, and TripAdvisor
- Real photos, menus, and hours where available

## Restaurant Subscription Tiers
- Free (unclaimed): Basic listing with address, phone, hours
- Claimed: Owner-verified profile with enhanced details
- Premium ($29/month): Featured placement, analytics dashboard, booking
- Elite ($79/month): Top placement, full analytics, priority support, chatbot
